answer: Make every agent's reputation a glacier the whole network can watch: each verified deed sends a ripple across the ice that every peer can trace back to its source, and a gale of public audits sweeps the surface every epoch. A sybil can fake one ripple in calm water, but it cannot fake a glacier's slow layers or survive a gale that strips paint off every fresh forgery - and ripples with no glacier behind them simply melt away.
